'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC Physician for [[Xuanfang Huaxu Academy]] who only works at night.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Chong:''' Strange. Where did my pen go? I even wrote my name on it...
:'''Chong:''' Must've dropped it. A [[Smeltguard]] probably snatched it off the ground...

==Dialogue==
:'''Chong:''' Here for medicine or a consult? For a consult, see Doctor Fuchang at the triage desk. For medicine, you can give me your prescription.

:{{DIcon}} Eh? Are you new here?

:{{DIcon}} Isn't it Doctor Chi during the day?

:'''Chong:''' Oh, you're looking for Chi. I'm in charge of meds during the night shift. If you're looking for him, come back during the day.

:{{DIcon}} So you work shifts.

::'''Chong:''' Can't be helped. It's too much work for one person to handle alone.

:{{DIcon}} Night shifts must be rough.

::'''Chong:''' Not at all. I actually prefer it. Fewer patients, and it's much slower than daytime hours.

:'''Chong:''' He takes the day, I take the night. The two of us splitting the load works out well enough.

:'''Chong:''' Of course, if we could have a day with no patients, that'd be even better...
{{Dialogue End}}
